title: subenum run-quality report
description: The report -stats writes, and the last line of -format jsonl output. Schema 1: fields are only ever added, so readers must accept fields they do not know; renaming or removing one, or changing its meaning, raises schema. See https://tmhsdigital.github.io/subenum/output.html.

type.description: Always summary: tells the report apart from the results in JSONL output.

version.description: The subenum version that wrote the report.

duration_ms.description: How long the run took, in milliseconds.

simulated.description: true for a -simulate run, whose results are invented.

resolver.description: The -dns-server, shown as its scheme and host only; with -simulate-zone, the lab's local server; with -r, the trusted resolver pool hits were re-validated against. Absent under -simulate.

transport.description: How queries reached the resolver: udp (with TCP fallback), tls (DNS over TLS) or https (DNS over HTTPS). Absent under -simulate.

rate_limit.description: The -rate cap in queries per second; 0 is unlimited.

queries_sent.description: DNS queries sent on the wire, every target, record type, retry and probe included.

achieved_qps.description: queries_sent divided by the run's duration.

verdict.description: The worst target verdict: how far the results, and the absence of other names, can be trusted.

reason.description: Why the run got its verdict, in plain words.

targets.description: One entry per target, in scan order.

resolvers.description: The -r pool's per-resolver accounting. Absent without -r.

status.description: skipped: left out after an earlier target's reliability abort; not_run: never reached.

error.description: Why a failed target failed. Absent otherwise.

processed.description: Candidates the main pass looked up.

total.description: Candidates the main pass had, recursion levels included.

queries_sent.description: This target's queries, its -permute pass included.

stopped_by.description: The budget that skipped candidates: -max-queries or -max-duration. Absent when none did.

takeover_candidates.description: Results with a takeover hint. Absent when 0.

internal_addresses.description: Results with a loopback, private, link-local, unspecified or CGNAT address. Absent when 0.

retried.description: Inconclusive names -retry-inconclusive looked up again. Absent when 0.

recovered.description: Retried names that then got an answer. Absent when 0.

rate_backoffs.description: Times -auto-rate halved the rate. Absent when 0.

final_rate.description: The rate -auto-rate ended at, in queries per second. Absent when it never backed off.

permutation.description: The -permute pass. Absent when none ran.

ct_names.description: Names Certificate Transparency added; repeats the ct entry of sources. Absent when 0.

ct_error.description: Why the Certificate Transparency lookup failed; repeats the ct entry of sources. Absent otherwise.

sources.description: One entry per passive source asked (-ct, -sources). Absent when none was.

axfr_allowed.description: Name servers that allowed an -axfr zone transfer, a misconfiguration. Absent when none did.

axfr_names.description: Names zone transfers added as candidates. Absent when 0.

axfr_error.description: Why no zone transfer could be tried, such as a failed NS lookup. A refusal is not an error. Absent otherwise.

axfr_found.description: Results a zone transfer had proposed. Absent when 0.

zone_denial.description: How the zone proves a name does not exist, from -axfr's DNSSEC probe: nsec means anyone can list it by walking it. Absent when not probed or no server answered.

pool_hits.description: -r: names a pool resolver said exist. Absent when 0.

confirmed.description: -r: pool hits the trusted resolver confirmed. Absent when 0.

unconfirmed.description: -r: pool hits the trusted resolver denied. Absent when 0.

wildcard.description: true when the target answers names that do not exist.

wildcard_fingerprint.description: The wildcard's answers, which results matching them are filtered by. Absent without a wildcard.

verdict.description: The worse of the main and -permute passes' verdicts.

reason.description: Why the target got its verdict; starts with permutation pass: when that pass decided it.

wildcard_filtered.description: Answers that matched the wildcard fingerprint and were dropped.

excluded.description: Candidates out of scope under -exclude, never queried.

processed.description: Candidates the pass looked up. Absent when 0.

queries_sent.description: The pass's own queries, also counted in the target's. Absent when 0.

verdict.description: The pass's own verdict. Absent when it did not scan.

names.description: Names it added as candidates and -permute seeds.

found.description: Results it had proposed, whoever else did too.

error.description: Why its lookup failed; the scan went on without it. Absent otherwise.

truncated.description: true when the source stopped at one of its limits, so some names may be missing. Absent otherwise.

address.description: The pool member, shown as its scheme and host only.

benched.description: Times it was taken out of rotation for failing.

throttled.description: Times a lookup found its -rate-per-resolver cap spent.

flagged.description: true when it was taken out of rotation as lying.

removed.description: Previous names a fresh lookup found gone (NXDOMAIN). Stays 0 when the run was not complete.

changed.description: -diff-records: names whose records changed. Absent when 0.

still_resolving.description: Previous names this run did not have as candidates but that still resolve. Absent when 0.

unverified.description: Previous names that could not be looked up again. Absent when 0.
